changes.code: VISA ISSUER FX CALCULATOR (FORMERLY KNOWN AS OIF):
cells:
Visa Issuer FX Calculator
(formerly known as OIF):

Visa calculates an optional issuer-determined amount for multicurrency
and/or cross-border transactions if requested by the issuer. This value is
calculated based on the percentage rate specified by the issuer and added to
the billing amount. The value is informational only and not included in the
settlement amount.

changes.old:
An optional additional currency fee requested by the issuer and collected as
part of the billing amount, if desired by the issuer. This fee is not included in
the settlement amount. It may be a debit or credit.

changes.old:
Visa Resolve Online provides dispute management services, including
transaction research, e.g. for cardholder queries, dispute questionnaires to
collect relevant customer information and documentation, financial
transaction processing (both BASE II and V.I.P. full financial) for disputes,
fraud reporting, Account Screen Authorization file (ASAF), stop payments,
and case filing (arbitration and compliance) capabilities. Visa Resolve Online
identifies associated transactions, e.g. credits, adjustments, and consolidates
the dispute history in case folders. To access Visa Resolve Online a client may
use either the VROL user interface accessed through Visa Online or a web-
service-API system interface (Real Time System Interface - RTSI).
changes.new:
Visa Resolve Online provides dispute management services, including
transaction research, for example, for cardholder queries, dispute
questionnaires to collect relevant customer information and documentation,
financial transaction processing (both BASE II and V.I.P. full-financial) for
disputes, fraud reporting, Account Screen Authorization file (ASAF), stop
payments, and case filing (arbitration and compliance) capabilities. Visa
Resolve Online identifies associated transactions, for example, credits,
adjustments, and consolidates the dispute history in case folders. To access
Visa Resolve Online a client may use either the VROL user interface accessed
through Visa Access or a web-service-API system interface (Real Time System
Interface - RTSI).
changes.ai_reason: El texto describe lo mismo pero con cambios menores en la redacción, como 'e.g.' a 'for example' y 'Visa Online' a 'Visa Access'.
